extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians considering submitting to Annales de l'Institut Fourier (prospective authors)
extracted.subtask_description: High-level summary of the Annales de l'Institut Fourier's aims and basic submission/publishing policies: the journal publishes original, high-quality mathematics articles in English or French, across all mathematical fields, with the electronic version open access and no author fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Les Annales de l’Institut Fourier ont pour objectif de publier des articles originaux et de haut niveau
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal's objective is to publish original and high‑level (haut niveau) articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement of editorial aim; implies submitted papers should contain original research and be of high scholarly standard. No further scoring guidance or examples provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Langue de publication : en anglais ou en français
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles may be submitted and published in English or in French.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit language policy given as 'en anglais ou en français'. No additional guidance (e.g., on bilingual abstracts or translations) is provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domaine : dans tous les domaines des mathématiques
rubrics_metrics.description: The scope covers all areas (tous les domaines) of mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates broad topical scope within mathematics; no specialization or subject restrictions listed on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accès et frais : intégralité de la version électronique en accès libre, sans aucun frais pour les auteurs
rubrics_metrics.description: The entire electronic version is open access and there are no fees charged to authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy statement about publication model: full open access and no author charges. No further details on licensing (e.g., CC license) or archiving policies are given on this page.
